answer: Continuous Physical Co-presence Ledger. Each agent identity must periodically prove it occupies a distinct physical volume by co-signing a radio beacon challenge with a fixed, locally installed transceiver bound to that site; the dune-deployed relay network timestamps each handshake. A single operator cannot fake two identities sitting in different places at the same instant. Reusing one transceiver for many IDs collapses them into one site. Attacker cost: one physical haven plus hardware per identity, defeating cheap mass duplication.
